weakness: SYS-01 and SYS-02 administrator accounts use a password only; email uses text-message codes
remediation_plan: Turn on app-based MFA in SYS-01 and SYS-02; register a security key on email and the government sign-in account, then remove text-message codes
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on SYS-01 and SYS-02; 2026-10-31 security keys registered and tested
resources_required: Two security keys about $60; owner time (2 hours)

weakness: External SYS-01 users sign in with a password only
remediation_plan: Give subcontractors two weeks' notice, then require MFA for all SYS-01 users

weakness: Default router password (fixed 2026-07-21); shared and reused passwords; no lost-phone procedure; accounting password unchanged since 2023
remediation_plan: Password manager with unique passphrases; separate bookkeeper account and new owner password; recovery codes in the sealed envelope; default passwords changed before first use (POL-01 7.3)
milestones: 2026-07-21 router password changed; 2026-09-15 password manager in use; 2026-09-30 bookkeeper account and new password

weakness: FCI in the AI tool and the personal photo cloud; no terms for the bookkeeper's device; no prohibited external systems
source: P07 assessment (AC-20 objectives); P03 G-003 and G-024
remediation_plan: Approved locations for FCI (POL-01 8.2); photo sync off for work; deletion request to the AI vendor for FC-1 uploads; security terms added to the bookkeeper engagement letter
milestones: 2026-09-15 photo sync off and AI deletion request sent; 2026-09-30 engagement letter signed

weakness: Home network shared with family and smart-home devices; router remote administration was open; covered hotspot used until 2026-07-16
remediation_plan: Update or replace the router; separate work network and guest network for family and smart-home devices; quarterly firmware and connected-device check
milestones: 2026-07-21 remote administration off; 2026-09-30 work network in place

weakness: Laptop files and security documents not backed up
source: P07 assessment (CP-09a. and CP-09c.); P01 R-012
remediation_plan: File sync with version history for the laptop work folder; security documents and evidence folder in the business file storage; quarterly SYS-01 export
milestones: 2026-09-15 security documents moved; 2026-10-31 sync on and first SYS-01 export saved
resources_required: Included in the email and file plan

weakness: No reporting duty for contractors; no notification contact list
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook and notification matrix; printed contact card; add a 1-business-day notice duty to the bookkeeper engagement letter and the federal subcontract rider
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook adopted; 2026-09-30 contact card printed and runbook walked through with the IT technician

weakness: No Section 889 manufacturer check before purchases
source: P07 assessment (SR-05[01]); P03 G-028 and G-031
remediation_plan: Manufacturer check before any network, phone, or camera purchase and in federal submittals (POL-01 6.4); return the hotspot; documented inquiry before the next SAM renewal
milestones: 2026-08-31 POL-01 6.4 adopted; 2026-09-30 hotspot returned; 2026-10-31 SAM representation reviewed
